note: Release record for tools/publish.py (RELEASE-01, docs/PUBLISH.md). Packages are listed in tag order. `commit` is what the publish expects on `branch`; `evidence` says where the green run at that commit is recorded. `verify` runs in a clean clone after the URL switch ({base} is the remote base); app `resolve` runs in the app worktree to produce `lockfiles`. Decisions stay null until the user records them with `tools/publish.py decide`.
